scope: Request-scoped immutable configuration lookup view for work-inbox authorization; no API wiring included.

notes: Counts/timings are cProfile data from the real HTTP route, before API wiring of the new view.
The profiler added substantial overhead (about 40 seconds across two measured requests); those wall times are not benchmark evidence and are intentionally omitted.
The profile also showed a separate clone_for_preview/preflight cost; it was left out of this scoped change.

implementation: ReadAuthorizationView delegates authorize, authorize_read, _qualified, _scope, and resolve to the exact Engine implementations rebound to the view.
Only RoleAssignment, Project, and Qualification are cached; values come from Engine.get deepcopies wrapped with the standard read-only mapping/sequence views.
Record reads delegate to Engine.get; Engine.at remains delegated so every call checks current time. The view must be constructed inside each held read transaction.
tests: tests_mvp.test_read_authorization_view: decision parity across human fixture roles, inbox records, and transition authorities.
Explicit expiry, missing/revoked qualification, fresh request role invalidation, recursive immutability, descendant scope, and internal report recipient cases.
tests_mvp.test_parallel_workspace_api and tests_mvp.test_wave3_inbox_composition passed before API route wiring.
